steps: Create sandbox/demo-app/test_storage_existing.py with a weak test: it writes '[]' to a file, calls storage.save_records with a value json cannot serialize ({1, 2}), and asserts the file still reads '[]'. The existing content is '[]', so the assertion cannot tell a preserved file from one overwritten with an empty list.
In sandbox/demo-app/storage.py, serialize the records to JSON text before opening the target path.
Write the serialized text in a single write, so that a serialization failure leaves any existing file untouched.
